info.title: sentry-ducklake API
info.description: Query and manage errors stored by sentry-ducklake. Ingest uses the Sentry protocol at /api/{project_id}/envelope/.

get.description: Events of one trace across all projects (for linking errors to traces).

parameters.name: trace_id
parameters.description: Trace id (32 hex characters). Required.

parameters.name: span_id
parameters.description: Only the event captured in this span (16 hex characters).

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Window to search, e.g. `24h`, `30d` (default `30d`).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max events (default 50, max 500).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the window (inclusive, RFC 3339).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the window (exclusive, RFC 3339). Defaults to now.

parameters.name: step
parameters.description: Bucket size for time series, e.g. `1h` (same as `interval`).

get.description: Error events of up to 200 traces at once, across all projects (for marking trace lists): per trace the event count and the newest 50 events. Traces without events are left out.

parameters.name: trace_id
parameters.description: Trace ids (32 hex characters), comma separated; at most 200. Required.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Window to search, e.g. `1h`, `30d` (default `30d`).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the window (inclusive, RFC 3339).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the window (exclusive, RFC 3339). Defaults to now.

parameters.name: step
parameters.description: Bucket size for time series, e.g. `1h` (same as `interval`).

get.description: One event by id, in any project (for looking up an id without knowing its project).

parameters.name: event_id
parameters.description: 32 hex chars

post.description: Flush inlined data to Parquet, apply retention, compact files and expire snapshots now.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Project id or slug

parameters.name: issue
parameters.description: Only events of this issue (16 hex characters).

parameters.name: trace_id
parameters.description: Only events of this trace (32 hex characters).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max events (default 50, max 500).

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Cursor from a previous page.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description:
Only events received in this window, e.g. `1h` (with `from`/`to`;
default: no window).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Case-insensitive text search in title and message.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the window (inclusive, RFC 3339).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the window (exclusive, RFC 3339). Defaults to now.

parameters.name: step
parameters.description: Bucket size for time series, e.g. `1h` (same as `interval`).

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Only events with this tag, `key:value`; repeat for more (all must match, max 10)

parameters.name: event_id
parameters.description: 32 hex chars

parameters.name: issue
parameters.description: Issue id; makes the lookup much faster on large projects.

get.description: Issues with events in the window. Pages: pass `next_cursor` as `cursor` with the same filters; the cursor carries the window and the sort.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Project id or slug

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: `unresolved` (default), `resolved`, `ignored` or `all`.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Case-insensitive text search in title and culprit.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Window, e.g. `24h`, `14d` (default `14d`).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `last_seen` (default), `first_seen`, `count`, `users`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max issues (default 50, max 500).

parameters.name: new
parameters.description: Only issues first seen inside the window (new issues).

parameters.name: first_release
parameters.description: Only issues first seen in this release.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
Cursor from a previous page (`next_cursor`). It carries the window
and the sort; pass the same filters.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the window (inclusive, RFC 3339).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the window (exclusive, RFC 3339). Defaults to now.

parameters.name: step
parameters.description: Bucket size for time series, e.g. `1h` (same as `interval`).

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Only events with this tag, `key:value`; repeat for more (all must match, max 10)

parameters.name: issue_id
parameters.description: 16 hex chars

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Window, e.g. `24h`, `14d` (default `24h` for stats, `14d` for issues).

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Bucket size for time series, e.g. `1h` (default: window / 24).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the window (inclusive, RFC 3339).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the window (exclusive, RFC 3339). Defaults to now.

parameters.name: step
parameters.description: Bucket size for time series, e.g. `1h` (same as `interval`).

patch.description: Set the status. Idempotent: when the issue already has that status nothing is written and `changed` is false.

get.description: Releases named by the project's events in the window (default 14d), newest last event first. Derived from events: releases created with sentry-cli are not stored.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Window, e.g. `24h`, `30d` (default `14d`).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max releases (default 50, max 500).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the window (inclusive, RFC 3339).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the window (exclusive, RFC 3339). Defaults to now.

parameters.name: step
parameters.description: Bucket size for time series, e.g. `1h` (same as `interval`).

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Window, e.g. `24h`, `14d` (default `24h` for stats, `14d` for issues).

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Bucket size for time series, e.g. `1h` (default: window / 24).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the window (inclusive, RFC 3339).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the window (exclusive, RFC 3339). Defaults to now.

parameters.name: step
parameters.description: Bucket size for time series, e.g. `1h` (same as `interval`).

post.description: Read-only SQL over `events`, `issues` and `issue_activity` (ADR 0010). Off unless `query.enable_sql` is set; one SELECT, checked before it runs, interrupted after `query.sql_timeout`.

ApiError.description: Error body returned with every non-2xx response.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier. Derived from `name` when omitted.

payload.description: The full normalized (and symbolicated) Sentry event.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `before` to fetch the next (older) page.

trace_id.description: Trace id (32 hex) from `contexts.trace`, for linking to traces.

EventsByTrace.description: Error events per trace id. Traces without events are left out.

changed.description:
Only in `PATCH` answers: false when the issue already had that status
(nothing was written).

next_cursor.description:
Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page (same filters); `None` on
the last page. The cursor carries the window and the sort.

IssueStatus.description: Issue status. Resolved issues reopen automatically on a new event.

last_seen.description: Last event in the queried window.

trend.description: Event counts in equal buckets over the window, oldest first.

user_count.description: Distinct users in the queried window.

dsn.description: DSN to configure in the Sentry SDK.

Release.description: A release, derived from the events that name it.

first_seen.description: First event of the release in the window.

issues.description: Distinct issues with events in the window.

last_seen.description: Last event of the release in the window.

new_issues.description: Issues first seen in this release (`first_release`), at any time.

public_url.description: Base URL the DSNs are built from, e.g. `https://errors.example.com/sentry`.

retention_secs.description: How long events are kept, in seconds (0 = forever).

SqlRequest.description:
`POST /v1/sql`: one read-only `SELECT` over `events`, `issues` and
`issue_activity` (schema `lake.sentry`, the default, so `FROM events`
works).

rows.description:
Row values as JSON. Other types (timestamps, UUIDs, maps) are strings
or JSON objects.

truncated.description: True when more rows existed than `limit`.

unique.description: Distinct values of this key in the window.

TraceEvent.description: One error event of a trace, as `GET /v1/events/by-trace` lists it.

span_id.description: Span id (16 hex) the event was captured in.

TraceEvents.description: The error events of one trace.

count.description: All events of the trace in the window.

reason.description:
Why, e.g. `fixed in #123` (max 500 characters; default `user`).
Shown in the issue's activity.
